picks.title: AI reveals how a warming climate will intensify NZ's most extreme downpours
picks.excerpt: A generative AI model trained on 140 years of regional climate simulations produced 15,000+ simulated years for New Zealand, showing 1-in-100-year daily rainfall intensifies about 9% per degree of warming.
picks.rationale: Climate slot: a generative emulator produced 15,000+ simulated years and found 1-in-100-year rainfall rises about 9% per degree of warming. That is a concrete, quantified research result.

picks.title: Researchers develop conversational AI for self-driving labs
picks.excerpt: KRICT researchers let scientists steer self-driving labs in plain language: an LLM turns expert guidance into structured priors for Bayesian optimization, and discards the guidance when data contradict it, cutting the experiments needed.
picks.rationale: Lab-method slot: KRICT's LLM turns plain-language expert advice into Bayesian-optimization priors and drops that advice when the data contradict it. This is a different system from the 09-27 self-driving materials lab card.

picks.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
picks.excerpt: Ai2's FairStress benchmark reveals demographic differences in how LLMs defend and explain their decisions, even when their final choices appear fair — a behavioral-science style probe of model reasoning.
picks.rationale: AI-behavior slot: Ai2 released a new benchmark showing that LLMs justify identical decisions differently across demographic groups, even when their final choices look fair.

picks.title: New materials library could help AI design better sodium-ion batteries
picks.excerpt: University of Surrey researchers built a library of 28 sodium manganese oxide cathode compositions and trained a machine-learning model on the automated test data, as a seed dataset for AI-driven sodium-ion battery design.
picks.rationale: Materials slot: Surrey built a 28-composition sodium-ion cathode library with automated testing, a new open seed dataset for ML-driven battery design.

picks.title: Raman+NIR Spectra Improves Glucose Soft Sensing
picks.excerpt: A multimodal soft-sensing framework fuses Raman and NIR spectra and benchmarks PLS, gradient-boosted trees, CNNs and temporal convolutional networks to monitor glucose in bioprocessing, easing a bottleneck for continuous manufacturing.
picks.rationale: Bioprocess-sensing slot: a study that fuses Raman and NIR spectra and benchmarks ML models for real-time glucose monitoring in continuous manufacturing.
